definitions.meaning: One of a nation, a fellow-countryman, compatriot

quotations.old_english: Gif hwá his ágenne geleód bebycgge
quotations.english: if any one sell his own countryman

source_text: ge-leód, es; m. One of a nation, a fellow-countryman, compatriot; conterraneus, compatriota :-- Gif hwá his ágenne geleód bebycgge if any one sell his own countryman, L. In. 11; Th. i. 110, 3.
